item.title: Bike Lettering
item.description: I took on a project of completely redoing someones bike, i suggested custom lettering of whatever they wanted but they insisted on it being as close to the original as possible. I inverted the colors so the font is more vibrant. I can get a new picture this is the only one i have available to me at this moment.
